title: Validation
subtitle: Field validators, Zod, and when validation runs
description: Configure client-side validation for large nested forms.
content: Validation is optional and config-driven. Errors live on the snapshot and per-field state.

sections.title: When it runs
sections.content:
`validate.on`:

• **change** — after each set (can be heavy)
• **blur** — when a field is touched via `touch` / `onBlur`
• **submit** — only inside `save()` / explicit `validate()`
• **manual** — only when you call `validate` / `validateField`
